sources.fact: Historic field survey conducted in 2007 at 425 Mission Street. Raised ends above First and Fremont, seven tall granite-framed window bays, aluminum lettering and steel industrial wing windows.
Historic architectural inventory gives 870 feet overall, a 230-foot central pavilion, reinforced concrete, California granite facing and seven two-story windows.
Last bus departed August 7, 2010. Demolition began later in 2010, after the 2008–09 evidence used here.
